messages:
olivia: Morning — async rounds. Quick update on the audit + KMS work I ran overnight: completed 2/3 of the key rotations, but blocked when a service account failed decrypt. @samir can you take a look at inference-gw perms? cc @beatrice for any audit implications. :coffee:
samir: On it. Which exact role name? I can repro locally if you share the error snippet or logs.
olivia: Role is inference-gw-ops. Error in logs: `AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt` — minimal snippet below:
```
2026-03-15T03:12:31Z ERROR: kms:Decrypt denied for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef12-3456
```
beatrice: For the audit queue — I flagged three low-risk findings and one policy that references an old key alias (will break dev envs). Planning to open PRs tonight to remediate.
noah: FYI deploy-bot rolled back the canary at ~02:45 due to a 503 spike. Not sure if that's related to the KMS failure but worth correlating.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for service=inference-gateway cluster=prod-eu reason=503-spike (automated).
samir: I found the missing kms:Decrypt on the role. Patching the inline policy now, will run a local decrypt test and post results.
olivia: Thanks — that was the blocker for the rotation. After samir's patch I'll re-run the dry deploy. Blockers: none else unless bea's PRs conflict with infra changes. Today: samir will patch role and validate, bea to open the PRs, i'll re-trigger the rotation and monitor canary; pinging @noah to watch canary metrics. :eyes:
beatrice: PRs opened: #2389 (policy alias fix), #2390 (audit cleanup). CI passed. @olivia please merge when you confirm perms.
noah: Watching canary, will post perf snapshots to #eng-runtime in ~30m. :bar_chart:
samir: Patch applied, local decrypt test returned success logs: `kms:Decrypt ok` — ready to redeploy canary after infra sync.
olivia: Great — re-run scheduled for 10:15 UTC. Thanks team :tada:
